claimreg.note: Not vendored into pai-repo: the claim fold has one canonical source and a vendored copy would drift. Supply this exact file at any path and point the API at it via the claimreg_path constructor argument, the --claimreg-module CLI flag, or the CABINET_CLAIMREG_PATH environment variable; the loader verifies this pin before executing the module and fails loudly on mismatch. If the canonical module is legitimately updated, update this pin in the same commit as the first read_api use of the new bytes.
claimreg.role: canonical claim-register module; read_api.py uses ONLY its read paths (load_events / fold / forget_tombstones)
claimreg.runtime_dependencies: Python 3 standard library only (top-level: argparse, json, os, re, sys, datetime; function-level: time, hashlib) — no third-party packages, no sibling modules
